title: HAPPY TONY NOMINATION DAY @SCHMIGADOON!!!!! and HAPPY BIRTHDAY CINCiO...

And the person who scans your ticket. To our amazing ushers and everyone in front of house. To our crew and everyone backstage. Creative team. To our amazing smorgasbord.
